start: A gym member joined to a gym with a logo, leaderboard live, on Settings

steps.action: Open Settings, tap 'Your gym'
user_sees: Card 'YOUR GYM' with the gym name and 'Joined in the app as <name>'; rows 'Gym logo on my home screen', 'What my gym can see', 'Leave <gym>'
must_not: Another gym's name or logo

steps.action: Tap 'Gym logo on my home screen'
user_sees: The phone's own 'add to home screen' question with the gym logo
must_not: Two shortcuts added after one tap

steps.action: Tap 'What my gym can see'
user_sees: Page 'What my gym can see' with the intro 'Your gym's staff see how many workouts you did...' and the switch 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard', off
must_not: The switch on by default

steps.action: Turn 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' on
user_sees: The switch is on; back on Your gym the row says 'Your name shows on the leaderboard'
must_not: The change lost when the gym is not reached; other members seeing the full surname

start: A gym member joined to a gym, no open shop orders, on Settings, Your gym

steps.action: Tap 'Leave <gym>' (sub 'Your workouts stay on this phone. Your leaderboard numbers are removed from the gym.')
user_sees: Question 'Leave <gym>?' with 'Your workouts stay on this phone. You can join again with the code.' and buttons 'Leave gym' and 'Stay'
must_not: Leaving without a question

steps.action: Tap 'Leave gym'
user_sees: The app goes back to the Gym tab's join screen; a branded app goes back to MettleUp's colours
must_not: Workouts on the phone deleted; gym reminders still arriving afterwards

start: A gym member with one open shop order, on Settings, Your gym

steps.action: Tap 'Leave <gym>'
user_sees: The question names the open order, for example 'You have 1 open order (Rs 450). Leaving cancels it.'
must_not: The order left open at the gym after the member leaves

steps.action: Confirm; the gym cannot be reached
user_sees: 'Your order isn't cancelled yet' with 'Try again' and 'Not now'
must_not: The member left the gym while the order is still placed

start: A gym member whose gym has trainer view and Busy machines on, on What my gym can see

steps.action: Open 'What my gym can see'
user_sees: Intro without 'never sends which exercises you did'; line about machines; switches 'Share which machines I use' (on) and 'Share my workouts with my trainers'
must_not: The old intro that says exercises are never sent while best sets go to trainers

steps.action: Turn 'Share my workouts with my trainers' off
user_sees: Switch off; 'Ask my trainer for help' goes
must_not: The gym keeping the trainer summary after the switch is off

start: A member with no gym joined, opening an old link to Settings, Your gym or What my gym can see

steps.action: Open the address /settings/gym (for example from the What's new line 'To leave your gym, open Settings, then Your gym')
user_sees: The Gym tab's 'Join your gym' screen
must_not: An empty 'Your gym' page; a Leave row with no gym name

start: A gym member whose gym's leaderboard has not answered in this app session (or is off)

steps.action: Open Settings, Your gym
user_sees: No 'What my gym can see' row; 'Leave <gym>' still shows
must_not: An error card

steps.action: Open What my gym can see from an old link
user_sees: Only the words 'Your gym's leaderboard is not switched on yet.'
must_not: A name switch that sends nothing; a blank page

start: A gym member on a phone whose home screen does not take shortcuts, or a gym with no logo

steps.action: Open Settings, Your gym
user_sees: No 'Gym logo on my home screen' row
must_not: A row that does nothing when tapped

steps.action: Logo row shown, internet off, tap it
user_sees: 'Couldn't get <gym>'s logo. Check the internet and try again.'
must_not: A blank shortcut icon added

start: A gym member with the name switch on, then off; then leaves and joins again

steps.action: Turn 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' off
user_sees: Switch off; row sub back to 'Your name on the leaderboard'
must_not: Other members still seeing the name after the gym's next refresh

steps.action: Turn 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' on while the name switch is off
user_sees: Line 'Gym mates can open your workouts only while 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' is on.'
must_not: Mates able to open the workouts with the name off

steps.action: Leave the gym, then join it again with the code
user_sees: Name switch off again (the choice is forgotten on leave)
must_not: The old name choice silently kept on; old shared workouts still at the gym

start: A gym member on What my gym can see

steps.action: Read the page and the switches
user_sees: The intro says staff see workouts and kg per day with the name; other members see 'A member'
must_not: The page shown to a member of another gym; staff words that hide what is sent

steps.action: Leave the gym
user_sees: Leaderboard numbers, trainer summary, machine use and shared workouts removed from the gym
must_not: The gym still showing the member's numbers or shared workouts after leaving
